sampling: Equally weighted samples at t=j/80; cumulative intervals include both endpoints.
selection_rule: Use the two specified relocation examples. Recompute global MAC-maximizing assignments before applying all nine threshold pairs. Assignments and accepted triples are independent of ports. Each before/after comparison uses the same triples; the common set is the intersection across all nine threshold pairs.
path_definition: H_theta=(1-theta)*H_rom+theta*H_continuous. Ritz and grid phase terms use H_theta; source/receiver residue differences use (1-theta)*cos(omega_continuous*t)+theta*cos(omega_rom*t). theta=0 is the manuscript's fixed-ROM-residue intervention. Other paths change the attribution convention and hence the intervention; their signs are reported without a success condition.
